form.label: Imperva IOC Block V2 – Auto unblock
form.description: IP rules of every WAF policy are unblocked when the IP sent no request for a while: cloud provider IPs (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure ...) after the cloud period, other IPs after the default period (see Settings). The countdown starts at the latest of the last attack (Imperva "Blocked IP" log), the block date and the day V2 first saw the rule. Runs every day at 02:17 ("Imperva V2 - Auto unblock (daily)"). Every action is written to the audit log.

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=list | eval _r=$a_refresh|s$
| stats count
| where status_code="attacking" | stats count
| where status_code="due" | stats count
| where status_code="kept" | stats count
| where cloud_provider!="-" | stats count

panel.title: Settings – saved in the KV store, written to the audit log

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=settings | eval _r=$a_refresh|s$ | eval v=split("on,off", ",") | mvexpand v | eval label=if(v="on", "On - unblock every day", "Off - nothing is unblocked").if(v=enabled, " (saved)", ""), o=if(v=enabled, 0, 1) | sort o | table label v

input.label: Unblock IPs after no attack for

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=settings | eval _r=$a_refresh|s$ | eval v=split("30,60,90,180,365", ",") | mvexpand v | eval label=v." days".if(v=default_days, " (saved)", ""), o=if(v=default_days, 0, 1) | sort o num(v) | table label v

input.label: Unblock cloud provider IPs after no attack for

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=settings | eval _r=$a_refresh|s$ | eval v=split("1,3,7,14,30", ",") | mvexpand v | eval label=v." days".if(v=cloud_days, " (saved)", ""), o=if(v=cloud_days, 0, 1) | sort o num(v) | table label v

| makeresults | impervaautounblock action=settings | eval _r=$a_refresh|s$ | eval v=split("all,own", ",") | mvexpand v | eval label=if(v="all", "All enabled policies", "Own policy only (policy_ids)").if(v=scope, " (saved)", ""), o=if(v=scope, 0, 1) | sort o | table label v

| makeresults | impervaautounblock action=settings | eval _r=$a_refresh|s$ | eval v=split("10,25,50,100", ",") | mvexpand v | eval label=v." rules".if(v=max_per_run, " (saved)", ""), o=if(v=max_per_run, 0, 1) | sort o num(v) | table label v

| makeresults | eval Save="💾 SAVE SETTINGS", settings="auto unblock ".$a_en|s$." · IPs ".$a_def|s$." days · cloud ".$a_cloud|s$." days · ".if($a_scope|s$="all", "all enabled policies", "own policy only")." · ".$a_max|s$." per run" | table Save settings

| makeresults | impervaautounblock action=settings enabled=$a_en|s$ default_days=$a_def|s$ cloud_days=$a_cloud|s$ scope=$a_scope|s$ max_per_run=$a_max|s$ | eval _s=$a_save|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time user action status detail

panel.title: Run now – unblock what is due (same as the daily run)

search.query: | stats count(eval(status_code="due")) AS due count(eval(status_code="due_not_managed")) AS not_managed | eval Run=if(due>0, "▶ RUN NOW (".due." due)", "Nothing due now"), note=if(not_managed>0, not_managed." due in policies outside the scope (not changed)", "-") | table Run due note

panel.title: Auto unblock result – written to the audit log (click a row to close)

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=run | eval _r=$a_run|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip action status verified policy ticket description detail

panel.title: IP rules on the WAF – all policies (📌 Keep = never unblock · ↺ Default · 🔓 Unblock now)

input.label: Reason for Keep / Default / Unblock now ("-" if none)

search.query: | eval _f=$a_f|s$, _q=lower(trim(replace($a_q|s$, "[*]", ""))) | where _f="all" OR status_code=_f OR (_f="due" AND status_code="due_not_managed") OR (_f="cloud" AND cloud_provider!="-") OR (_f="own" AND own_policy="yes") OR (_f="other" AND own_policy="no") | where _q="" OR like(lower(ip." ".policy_id." ".policy_name." ".ticket." ".description." ".owner), "%"._q."%") | eval Keep=if(status_code="kept", "-", "📌 Keep"), Default=if(rule_reason!="-" OR status_code="kept", "↺ Default", "-"), Unblock="🔓 Unblock now" | table Keep Default Unblock ip status last_attack unblock_after unblock_on days_left cloud_provider owner policy_id policy_name blocked_at listed_since ticket description rule_reason | rename last_attack AS "Last attack", unblock_after AS "Unblock after", unblock_on AS "Unblock on", days_left AS "Days left", cloud_provider AS "Cloud provider", policy_id AS policy, listed_since AS "Watched since", rule_reason AS "Rule reason"

format.colorPalette: case(like(value,"Due · unblock%"),"#5A9BD5", like(value,"Due%"),"#708794", like(value,"Attacking%"),"#DC4E41", like(value,"Unblock soon%"),"#F8BE34", like(value,"Kept%"),"#53A051", true(),"#3C444D")

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=set ip=$a_set_ip|s$ policy_id=$a_set_pid|s$ rule=$a_set_rule|s$ reason=$a_reason|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip policy action status detail description

panel.title: Unblock now – result (written to the audit log; the list updates after the next policy refresh, 5 min) · click to close

search.query: | makeresults | impervablock action=unblock ip=$a_unb_ip|s$ policy_id=$a_unb_pid|s$ description=$a_reason|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip policy action status verified backend soar_container detail

panel.title: Policies with BLOCK IP rules – for "All enabled policies" their IDs must be in IMPERVA_POLICY_IDS on SOAR

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=policies | eval _r=$a_refresh|s$ | table policy_id policy_name own_policy managed block_ip_rules cloud due

panel.title: Auto unblock log – last 30 days (audit log)

search.query: | inputlookup imperva_audit | eval _t=tonumber(time) | where _t>=relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") AND (user="auto-unblock" OR like(action, "auto_unblock%")) | sort 0 - _t | eval time=strftime(_t, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), ticket=replace(coalesce(ticket, "-"), "(?i)ITHM\s*-?\s*", "") | table time user action ip policy status description detail
